data.long_meaning: Derived from the root 'tamada', meaning 'to confirm' or 'to promise'. In Islamic history, Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) used this name for a companion, implying trustworthiness and reliability. The name Moutamad carries the meaning “Confirmation, promise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Moutamad usually hope their child will grow to embody confirmation, promise and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moutamad total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
